_comment: LXM-REQ-000240: literals in the Master's own tool code that look like configuration. tooling_literals.py counts them per file and kind; CI fails when a count rises (the ratchet), so hard-coding only goes down. Moving a literal into a registry lowers the count; write the new baseline with --write-baseline to a new file and submit it through the gate (kind: registry), like every registry (LXM-REQ-000253).

identifier format._comment: the prefixes and clause marker of every namespace in ids.json

ids.py · file or path.reason: the registry expander names the two registries it starts from (ids.json and layout.json): the one starting point every registry needs

assimilate.py · number.reason: mechanism, not configuration: a regex group number and a position in a plan step the gate builds itself

build.py · number.reason: mechanism, not configuration: the count of command-line arguments and a regex group number

knowledge_status.py · number.reason: mechanism, not configuration: a regex group number

states.py · number.reason: mechanism, not configuration: the header lines of its own report, skipped when it prints the summary

validate.py · number.reason: mechanism, not configuration: the count of command-line arguments

intake/ci-package/step_commit.py · file.reason: the step tool names its own configuration beside it: the one file it must find before any registry is reachable
